_what: The generated number ledger read by the numeric-literal gate at quality/check_numbers.py.
_generator: tools/comms/export_numbers.R, which writes this file from app/data/*.rds and out/tables/*.csv.
_rule: Every entry is a number a model produced, carried here by the generator with the file it came from. Nothing in this file is typed in by hand; a hand-written entry defeats the gate it feeds.
_state: The join slots are filled. W6.4 carried them from the join and the warehouse. The chapter-one model slots are still empty and fill on the first export run.

_entry_shape.value: the number, as the model produced it
_entry_shape.source: the repository file the generator read it from
_entry_shape.produced_by: the SOP step that wrote that file

entries.what: MLB 2026 regular-season game feeds pulled and stored, open set
pitch-slot rows extracted from those feeds on the corrected pitch key
MLB 2026 games carrying an absChallenges block, which are the games that reconcile
MLB 2026 challenge records, reviewType MJ, counted once across the three JSON locations
MLB 2026 challenges tallied by the feed's own gameData absChallenges block
MLB 2026 games where the challenge records and the gameData tally disagree
MLB 2026 challenges overturned, reconstructed from call_original
modal starting challenge allotment per MLB 2026 team-game
MLB 2026 team-games whose starting allotment is not the modal value, each an audit row
MLB regular-season called pitches, open set, batters with an ABS-measured height
MLB 2026 games in the join report
MLB 2026 pitches matched on both sides of the join
MLB 2026 rows unmatched on either side of the join
challenged MLB 2026 pitches offered to the drawer bridge
challenged MLB 2026 pitches with no bridge key
challenged MLB 2026 pitches sharing a bridge key with another called pitch in the same game

_join_slots: The entries carrying a `slot` key from SLOT_ORDER in ops/sprint_join_checkpoint.py are the join slots. W6.4 regenerates them in place and leaves every other entry alone. A later generator that rewrites `entries` wholesale must carry them forward or re-run W6.4.
_feed_slots: The entries carrying a `slot` key from SLOT_ORDER in ops/sprint_feed_checkpoint.py are the feed and challenge slots. W6.3 regenerates them in place, writes them ahead of the join slots, and leaves every other entry alone. A later generator that rewrites `entries` wholesale must carry them forward or re-run W6.3.
